dtype: FP64 for analytic geometry; inherited FP32 Open3D raycast for CAD; output depth FP32
point_protocol: ALL original native legal Polyp depth pixels, every identity retained; exceeds1000/source and covers all geometry strata

crop.aspect: smallest integer4k x3k virtual rectangle enclosing expanded bbox
crop.nearest: floor(inverse_affine_output_center+0.5), explicit original source pixel ID; no depth interpolation

thin_proxy: all local8-neighbour maxima of cv2 distance transform, width=2*DT; no connected component removed; proxy not certified anatomy; native predicted width and actual output width separately

metric_candidates.margin: max(2mm, 10% of max source extent) each side, then cube
metric_candidates.A: all native Polyp depths plus Ring CAD
metric_candidates.B_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: native points within1mm of own original Raw Mesh, inherited D0 native/Raw disagreement criterion; no input removed
metric_candidates.selection: NO automatic selection if far-point cube inflation or thin footprint problem; mark REQUEST_RESEARCHER_ROI_DECISION
metric_candidates.inflation_diagnostic: compare all vs B cube side; >1.5x is an explicit warning proxy, not anatomical truth

output_policy: No volume inference, no forward, no GT database; empty-shape/reset checks only; no fullROI dense scientific model
